curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As the Baron spins his outrageous recollections, can his ragtag crew pull through the increasingly unbelievable perils he describes?
curatedMovie.description: Baron Munchausen recounts supposed travels and fantastical experiences shared with his band of misfits.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Exciting, funny, and lighthearted fantasy with a steady pace that rewards an engaged family or friends night.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This adventure-comedy fantasy follows a larger-than-life storyteller and his band of misfits through fantastical experiences.
